CustomField.description: Apex-flavored regex matched against each result value. Every match is replaced with Replacement__c. An invalid pattern is skipped (logged) rather than failing the query.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Regex to match sensitive substrings, e.g. \b[A-Z]{2}\d{2}[A-Z0-9]{11,30}\b for IBANs. Invalid patterns are skipped.
CustomField.label: Pattern
